units.source_text: 少女们，以亚西西的圣方济各为首，虔诚地信奉背着十字架的主基督，

en.t: The girls, led by Saint Francis of Assisi, devoutly believed in the Lord Christ who bore the cross,

units.source_text: 她们的腋下好像被枪扎伤，

en.t: and under their arms it seemed as if they had been wounded by spears,
with a great deal of fresh blood flowing out.

units.source_text: 还有生灵、亡灵执念诅咒到将人咒死，这些故事无人不晓。

en.t: There were also stories everyone knew of living spirits and dead spirits whose obsessive curses could curse people to death.

units.source_text: 我知道你的噩耗，不禁毛骨悚然，我更加想变成花了。

en.t: When I learned the terrible news about you, I could not help shuddering, and I wanted even more to become a flower.
